title: ChallengeResponse
description: Response to an authentication challenge, containing the server-chosen nonce and a fresh client-chosen nonce. This is the structure that is signed and verified as authentication credentials.

Nonce.description: A unique random string. Authentication credentials have two of these: one generated by the server, and one by the client. This structure is agnostic to the syntax of the string.

RequestVerifier.description: The server half of an ephemeral request-signing key.
